items.text: Product section with name and URLs
items.evidence: What are the production, staging, and development URLs?
items.reason: The Product discovery section asks for the product name and the production, staging, and development URLs, and the examples record them.

items.text: Risk Areas table with at least 3 entries
items.reason: Risk Areas guidance requires the table to have at least 3 entries.

items.text: asking all 40 questions at once
items.reason: Asking all questions at once is listed as Anti-Pattern 1; the document says to walk section by section.

items.text: generic template without project specifics
items.reason: The document warns against leftover placeholders and generic flows and requires evidenced project specifics.

items.text: Risk Areas section empty or missing
items.reason: Skipping Risk Areas is listed as an anti-pattern; the section must be kept even if evidence is missing.

items.text: Test Stack section populated with Playwright and Jest
items.evidence: `vitest.config.*` / `jest.config.*` | Unit test framework → populate Test Stack Unit
items.reason: Codebase Detection instructs populating Test Stack E2E from playwright.config and Test Stack Unit from jest/vitest configs.

items.text: ask only about the unfilled sections
items.evidence: only about the unfilled sections, then update
items.reason: The workflow for a file with placeholders says to ask only about unfilled sections and preserve completed ones.

items.text: re-ask questions about already-completed sections
items.reason: The document explicitly says to preserve completed sections and ask only about gaps.

items.text: Which parts cause the most production incidents
items.evidence: Which parts cause the most production incidents?
items.reason: The Risk Areas discovery questions ask this directly.

items.text: Risk table with fewer than 3 entries
items.reason: The document requires at least 3 risk entries.

items.text: suggesting comprehensive regression test suites
items.evidence: Dedicated automation engineers, comprehensive regression suites, scheduled exploratory cadence.
items.reason: The Team ownership-model table prescribes comprehensive regression suites for QA-heavy teams.

items.text: flat Tech Stack without distinguishing components
items.reason: The document says to record frontend, backend, database, and hosting separately and per app in monorepos.

items.text: unclear which tests run for which app
items.reason: The document requires noting which CI path filters gate which app's suite.

items.text: recommending tools beyond the zero-infra defaults
items.reason: Anti-Pattern 5 forbids tool recommendations beyond the Playwright + Vitest zero-infra default.

items.text: no guidance on what to do next
items.reason: The workflow ends by suggesting the next skill based on the context.

items.text: 80% line coverage measured by Istanbul
items.reason: Quality Goals guidance gives this exact phrasing as a model numeric target.

items.text: 90%+ coverage for early-stage startup
items.reason: The maturity table sets 60% for early-stage startups and reserves 90%+ for enterprise.

items.text: recommending data-testid as only option
items.reason: data-testid is a default, with semantic/ARIA selectors offered as an alternative with tradeoffs.

items.text: Risk Areas table has at least 3 entries
items.reason: Risk Areas guidance requires at least 3 table entries.

items.text: at least 5 specific, testable key user flows
items.evidence: Key user flows must be specific and testable
items.reason: Product guidance demands specific, testable flows and says to aim for 5–10.

items.text: generic template text still present
items.reason: Leaving template brackets in the final file is listed as an anti-pattern.

items.text: missing URLs or environment names
items.reason: The document asks for URLs and environment names and the examples include them.
